batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b Simarjeet Singh

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c TU Deshpande b Simarjeet Singh

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b Simarjeet Singh

batting.name: Dhruv Jurel
batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b TU Deshpande

batting.name: SB Dubey
batting.dismissal: c S Dube b TU Deshpande

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: c Avesh Khan b N Burger

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: c R Parag b R Ashwin

balls.text: length ball slanted across the batter way outside off. Parag throws himself at it and shanks it off the inside edge. Rolls away to the bowler's right and Deshpande keeps it to one
what a shot that is! Simply stunning! Short, wide and sitting up to be hit. Parag still has plenty to do. He stands up tall and almost forehands it over long off. Novak Djokovic, eat your heart out!
very full outside off. Parag hangs deep in his crease and powers it on the bounce towards long on. Gaikwad accounts for the spin on the second bounce and reins it in
shortish outside off. No real pace on that and Ashwin can only slice it towards deep backward point

two in two for Tushar Deshpande! 117.1kph cutter dug into the track outside off. Dubey is way too early into the stroke. In fact, he plays two or three shots in his head before eventually dangling his bat out. Loops up to backward point, and Dube sends Dubey packing!

Jurel miscues, and Shardul snares it! Fullish outside off. Jurel, sitting back in his crease, tries to fight the angle and go leg-side but does so in vain. Slices across it too much and the ball spoons up towards extra cover. Shardul does not take it very cleanly, but that will do for now for CSK!
hard length outside off. Skids on, because of the two-paced nature of the surface, and Jurel splices it towards long on
in the slot outside off. Parag clears his front leg and heaves it towards long on. Rizvi cuts it off nicely and the release is quick enough to prevent the second
off-pace on a shortish length outside off. Jurel waits in his crease and cuts it towards deep point
low full toss outside off. Parag has a slog at it and drags it towards deep backward square leg

dropped! Another slower bouncer outside off. Gets up very high and Parag cannot get on top of it. Miscues his pull straight up and Rizvi, running in from long on, shells it. He did well to get there, and will be disappointed to have not held on
angled into the stumps. Jurel looks to force it away but cannot do so the way he wants. Chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off. Jurel hangs back and cuts it towards deep point
well well! Slants this a mile outside off, following Parag who has gone that way too. He tries to lap it fine but makes a hash of it. Pings off his body behind point
nails the wide yorker this time. Jurel squeezes it out towards deep cover point
into the stands! Juicy full toss outside off and that is a proper freebie. Jurel cannot believe what has been dished out and pounds it over cow corner!
another low full toss outside off. Parag has a mighty swing at it but shanks it towards deep mid wicket
low full toss just outside off. Jurel cannot get under it and clinks it down the ground to long on
short and slippery outside off. Parag throws the plumbing at it but only connects with fresh air again
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Goes over Parag's head and the square leg umpire, after a bit of thought, signals for the wide. Well above the head, in fact
hard length on middle and off. Rips through and hurries Parag all ends up. He is pretty late on the pull and misses
back to the off-pace ball. On a length just outside off. Parag tries to smash it into the sea and gets it as far as the front pad
just past Jadeja! Dug in short outside off. Parag, though, has telegraphed this. Waits on the back foot and belts it towards deep mid wicket. Jadeja flies to his right but cannot quite get there
slower ball on a length outside off. Jurel comes forward and eases it out to deep cover point
four more for Jurel! Goes for the leg-stump yorker but errs on the pads too much. Jurel uses the angle and clips it behind square!
shortish outside off. Parag has a wild swipe across the line and gets nowhere close to the ball
hard length just outside off. Jurel gets up on his toes and turns it towards deep mid wicket
extra bounce! Length delivery hung outside off. Kisses the surface and zips through. Jurel wafts at it and is beaten for pace and bounce
Jurel is up and running! Right in the slot on middle and leg. Jurel sits deep in his crease, snaps his wrists into the stroke and shovels it over deep mid wicket!
safe! Low full toss on middle and off. Jurel, in trying to swish it away to leg, closes his bat face too early. Skews off the leading edge and just evades mid off
length just outside off. Jurel gets behind the line and plays it back to the bowler. No width to work with for Jurel
cutter on a back of a length outside off. Jurel waits for it and punches it towards deep point
another bouncer, this time it is pace-on. Jurel sways out of the way. That was bowled at 136.4kph
slower bumper outside off. Parag fetches it from outside the line and swats it towards deep mid wicket
full just outside off. Jurel tips it to mid off and hares across to the other end. Might have been interesting had Gaikwad gathered cleanly

Simarjeet has three, and he is having a day out in the Chennai sun! Full outside off, and with mid off up, Samson goes after it. The ball, though, is full enough to deny him the elevation he desires. Arrows it straight to Gaikwad at mid off, and the CSK skipper makes no mistake!
length outside off. Parag backs away and throws the kitchen sink at it, edging it down to third man
slower bumper outside off. Balloons over the batter's head and called a wide for height
length just outside off. Samson gets on top of the bounce and pushes it past extra cover. By the time deep cover point comes around, Samson bags a brace
shorter outside off. Samson again finds Simarjeet at backward point with his cut
back of a length just outside off. Straightens just a bit and Samson cannot beat backward point with his cut
length just outside off. Parag drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
goes all the way! Darted into the slot on middle and leg. Parag picks the length early, bends his back knee and pummels this over deep mid wicket!
length on middle and off. Samson stays leg side and punches it down the ground to long off
into the blockhole just outside off. Parag tries to access the off side again but only connects with fresh air
very full outside off. Parag has a massive swish at it but is a little late on the stroke. Sneaks under his bat
angled in on a length on leg stump. Samson is content to flick it to long on
fullish outside off. Parag jabs it towards extra cover and picks up another single
carrom ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Parag works it into the vast open spaces in the mid wicket region and canters back for two
full on leg stump. Samson backs away and knocks it to long off
length outside off. Samson gives himself room and looks to go inside out. Slices it on the bounce to deep cover point
length just outside off. A bit of hold in the surface and Samson prods it towards extra cover
back of a length on the pads. Parag tucks it away towards deep backward square leg
darted in full on middle and leg. Samson pushes it down the ground to long off
just outside off. Samson punches it towards deep cover point. Another Theekshana misfield, and Samson can get back for two
dropped, oh dear! Full just outside leg. Parag brings out the reverse and hits it uppishly towards deep cover point. Theekshana comes around, has multiple bites at it but puts it down in the end
full on the stumps. Parag comes forward and tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
dug into the track on middle and off. Samson cannot get a hold of it and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
hard length just outside off. Parag stands up tall and punches it to long on
back of a length outside off. Samson waits for it and guides it down to third man
fuller on the pads. Parag flicks it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single this time because he hit it too firmly
back of a length on off. Parag bunts it into the mid wicket region and hits it with just enough weight to get back for two. That barely crossed the circle
length just outside off. Parag waits for it and dabs it towards backward point
full on middle and off. Samson gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Skids on and keeps a little low. Samson plays it back to the bowler
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Parag tips it towards extra cover and scampers across to the other end
length outside off. Samson presses half forward and knocks it to long off
full on off. Parag comes forward and pushes it towards long off
slower bumper outside off. Parag waits for it and then helps it into the mid wicket region
short again, but wider outside off. Parag throws his hands at it but ends up scuffing it towards backward point
off the mark in style! Simarjeet bangs it in short again, but Parag is ready for it. Rocks back, frees his arms and launches it over mid wicket. Just clears the fence!
sharp back of a length delivery outside off that rips through. Parag thinks about the pull initially before bailing out of it. That was bowled at just under 140kph
length outside off. Parag presses half forward and pats it gently towards backward point

the catch is taken, and Chepauk comes alive again! Full outside off. Buttler, feeling the pinch of the scoring rate, unfurls the lap. Does not get into a great position and cannot get as far across as he would have liked. Arrows it towards long long, where Deshpande runs well around the bend to his right and then snaffles up the chance. RR have now lost both of their openers in quick succession!
angled in full on the pads. Buttler works it away towards deep mid wicket
length just outside off. Buttler presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
very full on middle and leg. Buttler tries the reverse again and while he makes better contact, he cannot beat backward point
oh! Fuller and quicker outside off. Buttler looks for the reverse but scuffs it into Dhoni's pads. Not far away from the stumps either
tossed up full outside off. Samson comes forward and eases it towards long off
full outside off. Buttler comes forward and pushes it enough to extra cover's left for a single
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Buttler opens his bat face and runs it down to third man
short outside off again. Seems to rush onto Buttler quicker than he expects and he can only dab it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Nips back off the surface and Samson, up on his toes, bunts it to mid off to get off the mark
shortish outside off. Samson goes fishing at it away from his body and sees the ball squirm past the bat. That was bowled at 127.6kph, might have been a cutter
dug into the track just outside off. Samson gauges the length early enough and sways out of the way. More exercise for the umpire

goes straight up, and Simarjeet gets the breakthrough CSK wanted! Bangs it in on a hard length just outside off. Jaiswal, rather instinctively, goes for the pull. The ball, though, gets big on him and he cannot control it. Shanks it straight up and Gaikwad, running in from extra cover, does the rest. Big moment in the game!
sharp bumper on middle and off. Sails over the batter's head and Dhoni does well to get a glove to it. Called a wide
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal stands up on his toes and slices it towards backward point
finishes the powerplay with a boundary! Another full toss and this one is on the stumps. Buttler, after a brief shimmy, stands still and sweeps it past square leg!
darted in, following the batter outside leg. Buttler cannot free his arms and scuffs it towards extra cover
full toss outside off and Buttler has missed out here. Drills it straight to extra cover
fired in very full outside off, perhaps after seeing Jaiswal advance. He swishes at it and shanks it off the inside edge towards square leg
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal stays back and prods it into the off side

length on off. Buttler turns it to the bowler's right. Theekshana is close enough to it and the single is decided against initially. Then he fumbles, and then fumbles again to eventually allow the single
back to a hard length, just outside off. No room to work with for Jaiswal this time, and he stabs it towards cover
four more! Full and wide outside off. Jaiswal throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over point. The sweeper had just come in to reinforce the leg-side and Jaiswal made the most of it!
shot! Back of a length just outside off, and Jaiswal now knows what length is coming. Opens up his front hip and bashes this over the bowler's head!
back of a length outside off. This zips off the surface and whistles past Jaiswal's flailing blade
hard length just outside off. Seems to skid onto Jaiswal and he cloths his pull towards mid on. Another indication that this pitch is a little two-paced currently
full outside off. Buttler advances and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
cleverly done! Darted into the blockhole outside off. Jaiswal waits for it and uses the pace. Opens his bat face and glides it fine past the keeper!
very full on leg stump. Jaiswal tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket, and both batters have ample time to come back for two
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal stands back and prods it towards mid off
Jaiswal goes big! Slowed up and bowled into the slot on the stumps. Jaiswal gets down on one knee and belts it over the deep square leg fence!

full just outside off. Jaiswal stabs it back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it and parries it to mid off. Theekshana then tangles with Buttler, and that forces Jaiswal to decide against the run. Gaikwad's shy, though, was wide of the mark
fired in, following the batter way outside leg. Buttler can only tuck it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
cutter on a length just outside off. Buttler waits for it and flicks it towards mid on for a single
back of a length outside off. Buttler stays on top of the bounce and jabs it towards deep cover point for a brace
Buttler breaks free! Off-pace again but this is a half-tracker outside off. Buttler picks it up early enough and hammers it over mid wicket!
short outside off again. Buttler gets up on his toes and punches it nicely. Straight to extra cover, though
off-pace on a shortish length just outside off. Grips in the surface, spins back in and keeps a little low. Buttler swings across the line and misses
back of a length outside off. Buttler takes a step down the track before turning it towards mid wicket
length on middle and leg. Buttler comes forward tentatively and prods it just past the bowler to retain strike
quicker, flatter and shorter on middle and leg. Jaiswal is cramped for room and chunks his punch into his pads. The ball rolls away towards point, allowing a sharpish single
fullish on middle and leg. Jaiswal tries to work to leg but jams it off the inside edge into his front pad
carrom ball bowled full on middle and leg. Buttler drives it to long on
fuller on middle and off. Jaiswal gets a good stride in and knocks it to long on
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal pokes it into the off side off the back foot
back of a length outside off. Buttler gets on top of the bounce and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Buttler skips down the track and punches it neatly past cover point for a couple of runs
hard length just outside off. Buttler gets behind the line and defends
safe! Banged into the track on middle and off, and this gets big on Jaiswal. He has a swipe at it anyway and splices it. Luckily for him, it falls just in front of deep backward square leg
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal hangs back and pushes it towards cover
back of a length just outside off. A hint of shape into Jaiswal as he stays back and taps it towards cover

Rizvi finishes it off with a boundary! Chepauk erupts, and CSK move up to 14 points! Wide full toss and that is begging to be hit. Rizvi throws his hands at it and scythes it through point. Both batters might barely be able to hear themselves think, that is how loud it is at Chepauk, and this win is a big boost to their playoff hopes!
crrunnchhheeddd! Half-volley outside off and Rizvi pounces. Springs onto the front foot and crunches it with a high elbow, beating extra cover and mid off. Scores level!
banged into the track outside off. Gaikwad does not fiddle with this and sways out of the way
length outside off. Seems to straighten against the angle a shade and whizzes past the outside edge of Gaikwad's flailing blade
pick the bones out of this! Bumper outside off and Gaikwad climbs into it. Does not get up very high, and Gaikwad, having rocked back, clatters it over deep square leg!
slower and shorter outside off. Rizvi rides the bounce and runs it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Skids off the surface and Rizvi is late on the cut
fullish and angling into the stumps. Gaikwad pushes it down the ground to long on

fullish outside off. Gaikwad advances and bunts it towards extra cover. Sets off for the single straightaway and is helped by the fielder not collecting it cleanly. Gaikwad has seen better days running between the wickets, it must be said
dug into the track on off. Rizvi gets onto the back foot and pulls it confidently towards deep square leg
top shot under pressure! Low full toss that slants onto the pads. Rizvi snaps his wrists into the stroke and clips it past mid wicket!
slower bumper outside off that just does not arrive. Rizvi waits an eternity for it before eventually missing his attempted upper-cut
leg-cutter on a length on off. Gaikwad eases it down the ground to long on
back of a length just outside off. Rizvi gets up on his toes and punches it towards long on
length just outside off. Gaikwad presses half forward and defends

Drama at Chepauk! Shortish outside off. Jadeja uses the pace and the angle and glides it towards third man. Jadeja is hell-bent on the second, and is sent back by Gaikwad, who has not moved a muscle at the other end. Samson collects the throw and then fires it at the other end, catching Jadeja on the back in the process. Looks like RR have appealed for obstructing the field. Jadeja's turn had quite a sizeable radius, and the third umpire reckons Jadeja knew where the ball was, and that he turned into the line of the throw. 'Out' is the verdict, and Jadeja has to go. He is not happy at all, but the verdict is out. What a moment in this game!
back of a length on off. Gaikwad transfers his weight forward and knocks it to long on
slow and short outside off. Gaikwad lets the ball come to him before ramping it towards third man for a couple of runs
slower bumper way outside off. Gaikwad can only drag it towards deep mid wicket

oh dear, almost a run-out! Hard length just outside off. Jadeja tips it to extra cover and calls for the single. Gaikwad is late to respond and was well short had the throw hit the stumps at the batter's end!

saves the six, but cannot hold on to the catch! Tossed up generously on a length outside off. Jadeja skips down the track and aims for the moon. Slices it high up towards long on. Buttler leaps into the air, takes the catch but then pushes it back into play as he realises he will step onto the ropes. Excellent fielding effort, and it has saved RR five runs!
even slower on a full length just outside off. Jadeja lunges at it and defends
slider on a length outside off. Jadeja is caught on the crease and prods it towards point
given plenty of air and bowled full outside off. Jadeja gets to the pitch of the ball and whisks it enough to long on's left for a brace
flighted up full outside off. Gaikwad is beaten in the air as he comes down but manages to nurdle it towards short third
surgical precision! Short, wide and put away. There is vast acreage behind point, and Gaikwad uses that to perfection. Waits for it and then knifes it past backward point!
fired down leg. Gaikwad makes no contact and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

Dube falls to Ashwin! Ashwin dangles the carrot on a length just outside off and Dube bites. Has a huge swing at it but does not get to the pitch as much. Cloths it and the ball goes high up towards long on. Parag keeps his nerve, and then gobbles up the chance. Is there another twist in the tale?!
slower, fuller and slanted into leg stump. Dube plays all over it and gets pinged on the pads
short outside off again. Dube scuffs his cut towards cover point
Dube is tearing into Ashwin! Short and wide outside off. Dube does brilliantly to hold his stroke and scythes it past point!
slides this down leg. Dube lets it go and the umpire stretches out his arms
shot! Slower, wider and marginally shorter outside off. Dube reaches out for it and slaps it powerfully past extra cover. 10 runs off two balls this over!
Dube goes for it, and it goes an absolute mile! Darted into the slot on middle and off. Right up Dube's wheelhouse and he unleashes on it. Clubs it over long on!
fuller and flatter on leg stump. Dube helps it behind square and retains strike
slower again to Gaikwad. Full just outside off. Gaikwad advances and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length wide outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and chops it past the keeper for a single
shorter on middle and leg. Skids onto Dube and cramps him for room. Stabbed to short mid wicket
floated up fuller outside off. Gaikwad skips down and drives it towards deep cover point
fullish just outside off. Dube gets forward and knocks it to long on
full on middle and leg. Dube hangs back deep in his crease and flicks it to long on

Moeen holes out! Full, wide and there to be hit. Moeen goes through the line but does not quite commit to it fully. Times it well enough but does not have the power to clear the fence. Avesh does the rest at deep cover point, and RR are just beginning to inch back into the contest!
short outside off. Gaikwad sits back in his crease and pulls it towards deep square leg
hard length on middle and off. Gaikwad is a little squared up and plonks it towards mid off
fullish, angling into off. Gaikwad presses half forward and stabs it towards short mid wicket
shortish outside off. Moeen stands up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point
back of a length outside off. Moeen knocks it down the ground and retains strike
back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad hops back and turns it towards deep mid wicket
floated up full and wide outside off. Moeen resists the temptation and punches it to deep cover
back of a length on the pads. Moeen tucks it away between deep mid wicket and deep square leg, and picks up two
shortens his length after seeing Gaikwad advance. He keeps his eyes on the ball and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Moeen goes back and punches it towards long on
given a bit of air outside off. Gaikwad skips down and pushes it towards short extra cover
angled into the pads again. Moeen nudges it into the square leg region for a single
slanted into the batter, following him outside leg. Moeen pats it towards mid wicket
length on middle and off. Goes on with the angle and Gaikwad dabs it towards short third
full on middle and off. Moeen eases it down the ground to long off
length just outside off. Moeen comes forward and defends
short ball on middle and off. Moeen rolls his wrists over it and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
leg-cutter on a hard length just outside off. Gaikwad jabs it out towards deep cover point
shortish outside off. Gaikwad punches it neatly but cannot beat the fielder at extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Moeen glances it off his hips towards fine leg to get off the mark
banged into the track on middle and off. Moeen gauges the length early and sways out of the way. Called a wide
back of a length outside off again. Gaikwad opens his bat face much more and runs it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad waits for it and cuts it enough to deep cover point's left for a brace
googly on a length just outside off. Moeen gets onto the front foot and defends

huge appeal, and given! Chahal into the act straightaway! On a length on middle stump. Skids on and straightens just a shade. Mitchell plays all over it. Gets struck right in front and umpire Rohan Pandit raises his finger. Mitchell has a chat with his skipper, before deciding to go upstairs. No bat involved. Ball Tracking comes up, and it reckons the ball would have smashed into the top of middle stump. Mitchell has to go, and he takes a review along with him!
back of a length on the pads. Gaikwad eases it out towards deep mid wicket and is content with a single
length on middle and off. Gaikwad opts to stay back and taps it towards backward point
full on middle stump. Gaikwad lunges forward and smothers it
floated up on a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad presses half forward and defends
fullish just outside off. Gaikwad presses forward and drives it towards deep cover point
length just outside off. Mitchell gets his front foot out of the way and winds up for the big hit. Clinks it to long on ultimately
short outside off. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep cover point
Gaikwad lands his first punch! Marginally short on middle and leg, and Gaikwad is all over it like a rash. Rocks back and slams it over deep mid wicket. Disappears into the sea of yellow!
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards backward point
hard length just outside off. Mitchell opens up his stance and hacks it towards mid wicket
carrom ball on a length on off. Mitchell bunts it into the wide mid on region and wants two. Gaikwad, though, is not interested
shot! Fuller and flatter on leg stump. Mitchell gets down on one knee again and this time, paddles it between short fine and square leg!
carrom ball on the pads. Mitchell plays it straight to square leg
slowed up on a length outside off. Gaikwad plays with very soft hands and drops it behind point for a single
fired in full just outside off. Mitchell comes forward and knocks it to long on
Mitchell continues finding the fence! Length delivery well outside off. Mitchell picks the line early, moves across and sweeps it over square leg. One bounce and into the fence!
hard length just outside off. Mitchell has a stab at it and jams it off the inside edge into his back thigh. The ball rolls away towards Samson and Gaikwad is alert enough to sneak in a run
slower bumper that slides just down leg. Some more exercise for the umpire as Mitchell swings and misses
four more! Knuckle-ball but this is in the slot on middle and leg. Mitchell clears his front leg and muscles it through square leg. Not off the middle, but Mitchell will take it!
back of a length just outside off. Mitchell has no room to work with and defends it back to the bowler
nicely done! Back of a length ball that just strays onto the pads. Mitchell gets inside the line and tickles it fine past the keeper!
back of a length on middle and off. Gaikwad taps it towards backward point and calls for the single. Completed comfortably
back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad comes half forward and defends
fuller on middle and leg. Gaikwad flicks it away towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Mitchell turns it towards square leg and scampers across to the other end

Ashwin outfoxes Rachin! Fizzed through on a length on middle and leg. Rachin tries to smack this into next week and loses his shape. The ball seems to hold in the surface too, and the ball goes straight up. Ashwin calls for it early and does the rest. Just what RR needed at this stage!
fired in full on leg stump. Gaikwad presses forward and tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
angled into the pads. Rachin lets the ball come to him before pushing it towards mid on
back of a length on middle and leg. Rachin rocks back and whisks it towards deep mid wicket for a brace
shortish outside off. Gaikwad hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards backward point
sprays this down leg. Gaikwad does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length on middle and off. Rachin gets up on his toes and punches it towards long on
beautifully done! Goes shorter but Rachin has read this like the morning daily. He backs away, as soon as Boult releases it, and the room allows him to carve it over the third man fence!
finds the gap! Slower ball that goes awry and slides onto the pads. That is fodder for Rachin and he whips it away past deep square leg, beating him to his right!
hard length outside off. Rachin looks for the front-foot pull but cloths it towards mid wicket
banged in short on leg stump. Rachin backs away and has a huge swipe across the line. Sees the ball whistle past his flailing blade

more frantic running! Hard length, slanting into middle and leg. Rachin advances and swishes at it. Misses it completely and Samson cannot gather cleanly either. Gaikwad scurries across to the other end and makes it, despite the direct hit

missed chance! Full outside off. Rachin drills it towards extra cover, who misfields. Gaikwad responds to Rachin's initial call after the misfield, only to be sent back. The throw is wide of the mark, though, and Gaikwad survives
length just outside off. Rachin comes forward, stays on top of the bounce and punches it to mid off's right for a brace
lovely! Full, slanting into middle and leg. Rachin springs onto the front foot, brings his wrists into play and whips it over the wide long on fence!
back of a length on the stumps. Rachin uses the angle and flicks it away, albeit uppishly, through mid wicket for a couple of runs
full just outside off. Gaikwad takes a step down the track and pushes it towards long on
On a length outside off, Rachin creams a drive through cover, but the sweeper is up to it. He fumbles as he goes to pick the ball up but recovers before it trickles to the rope
Beaten! Length ball outside off, shaping away from the left-hander. Rachin skips down and has a big swing but is beaten on the outside edge
Full on off, shaping into Gaikwad, who nudges it towards mid-off for an easy single
Full on middle, he taps it to mid-on and they take a risky sinle. Direct hit at the non-striker's end could have seen Rachin in trouble!
Hard length outside off, shaping away, Rachin punches to cover
Starts off with a length ball outside off, pushed to point
